where.zh: 整個遊戲（航海、島嶼與戰鬥都播放同一首 6/8 拍水手歌）
where.en: The whole game (sailing, islands and fights all share this one 6/8 sea shanty)

tracks.play: /* music starts inside start(); nothing else needed */ void 0

harness.notes: js/audio.js exports class Sound (ES module). start() creates the context and immediately calls music(): a setInterval(60 ms) look-ahead shanty at 168 bpm (8 bars x 6 steps = 48 steps = 17.14 s) plus an always-on looping sea-noise bed (lowpass noise with slow LFO) on the master bus. musicOn defaults true. The sea noise is part of the render; it is quiet (gain 0.05).

notes: Only one song in the game; it starts automatically with start(), so 'play' is a no-op.
